## Row

::: {.card title="About this dashboard"}
This dashboard is an interactive evidence map built on a study-level
systematic review dataset of augmented reality (AR) and mixed reality (MR)
visualization in medicine. It covers **313 studies** published between 1996
and 2026.

All charts are generated from a single CSV file
([download](data/raw/review_dataset.csv)). Updating the CSV and re-rendering
the site refreshes every figure and table automatically.
:::

## Row

::: {.card title="Variable descriptions"}

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `record_id` | Unique identifier of each included study |
| `citation_key` | First author and publication year |
| `title` / `journal` / `publication_year` | Bibliographic information |
| `analysis_period` | Period bucket used in trend analyses (Before 2010, 2010-2015, 2016-2020, 2021-2026) |
| `study_summary` | One-sentence summary of the study |
| `case_report` | Whether the study is a clinical case report |
| `workflow_stage` | Clinical workflow stage(s) addressed: diagnosis, education, training, planning, intraoperative, method development |
| `specialty` | Clinical specialty of the application |
| `evaluation_target` | What the system was evaluated on: phantom, animal, cadaver, patient, human subject, dataset, virtual |
| `device` | AR/MR display device: optical/video see-through HMD, spatial monitor, projection, handheld, microscope, etc. |
| `dimensionality` | Dimensionality of the visualized content (2D, 3D, 2D+3D, 4D) |
| `image_modalities` | Medical imaging modality/modalities visualized (CT, MRI, ultrasound, X-ray, RGB, …) |
| `rendering_type` | Rendering approach: surface modeling, volume rendering, no post-processing, other |
| `aux_visualization_content` | Auxiliary visual content such as tool location or information panels |
| `anchoring_context` | Spatial anchoring of the virtual content: in-situ, off-situ, inter-situ |
| `registration_method` | Registration approach: optical marker, other marker, markerless, manual |
| `perception_support` / `perception_cues` | Whether and how depth-perception cues (occlusion, shadow, color, …) are provided |

Multi-label fields use a pipe (`|`) separator in the raw CSV and are split
into long-format tables before counting, so each study contributes one count
per label.
:::

## Row

::: {.card title="How to cite"}
If you use this dashboard or the underlying dataset, please cite the
accompanying systematic review (citation to be added upon publication).

The dataset is provided as Supplementary Data S1 of the review.
:::
